protocol: noising = exact reverse-time integration from upright under random torques (K<=200 steps); eval = swing-up from hanging +/-0.1 rad, success = reach and hold |theta|<0.15, |omega|<0.6 for 10 steps within 250; 2048 eval episodes, 30k iters each, identical 3x256 MLP backbone

denoise_mse_regression.note: epsilon-regression collapses to the posterior MEAN torque; near hanging the undo-torque posterior is bimodal (both spin directions), mean ~ 0 -> no energy pumping

denoise_categorical_21bins.note: same data, same backbone, cross-entropy over discretized torque: keeping the distribution (as diffusion samplers do) fixes the collapse

value_baseline_lookahead.note: cost-to-go bootstrapping over 9-torque grid + 1-step lookahead; slightly more efficient trajectories

finding: continuous domains break naive epsilon-REGRESSION, not the diffusion framing: the categorical/distributional denoiser succeeds; mode-averaging is the mechanism
